complexity.whyNaiveFails: Tree rotations one by one on arbitrary unbalanced trees are complex and can take quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Flattening to an array takes O(N) memory and rebuilds a height-balanced tree in O(N) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate utilizes in-order flattening followed by divide-and-conquer binary construction.
complexity.notes: Height is bounded by O(log N).
